evidence_note: MHA Annexure I links flood onset to 19 August and reports flood impact in all eight districts; names enumerated in the same annexure. Not linked to the separate 26 August EM-DAT event.
Ministry inspection identifies submerged crop fields in these three districts during this event. Visited districts are not an exhaustive damage inventory.

SDMA identifies flooding at Dalu in West Garo Hills and a washed-away river bridge at Gasuapara in South Garo Hills. Other districts occur in aggregated flood/landslide reporting and are not promoted here.

location: Assam, Bihar, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, Kerala, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Arunachal Pradesh, Maharashtraa.
evidence_note: IMD Disastrous Weather Events 2020, printed page 84 (PDF page 92), West Bengal row 3: 8-20 July heavy rains and floods; damage column explicitly identifies submerged houses in Jalpaiguri. Within the June-August parent interval, with no overlapping West Bengal parent in the audited registry. Not a complete affected-district inventory. EM-DAT Start Day is missing and remains missing; report publication day is unspecified. NIDM August 2021 webinar report page 5 also cites Jalpaiguri inundation (ECHO 13 July 2020).
